div.h3: Are you a certified TRE™ provider in Singapore?
div.p: Certified providers and providers-in-training can be listed here at no cost, with the same card, profile page and gallery as everyone else.
If you are a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer or senior provider visiting Singapore and would like to run a workshop or supervision day with our community, we would love to host you.

div.h2: All certified TRE™ providers in Singapore

ul.li: Isabelle Claus Teixeira — Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC Executive Coach · Mindfulness Teacher. Founder of TRE™ in Singapore; runs the full three-module certification and teaches individuals, groups and organisations.

Yan Lau — Holistic Healing & Wellness Facilitator · Certified TRE™ Provider. Holistic facilitator blending Family Constellations, Brainspotting, TRE™ and PSYCH-K® to clear subconscious blocks and heal generational patterns.

Nikki Tay — Certified TRE™ Provider · MEd Special Education. Certified TRE™ Provider drawing on nearly three decades in early-childhood and special education to offer a gentle, body-based way to release tension.

Rina Ho — Certified TRE™ Provider · Executive Coach · Former APAC Business Leader. Executive coach and certified TRE™ provider helping leaders and teams build resilience, self-regulation and sustainable performance, after 25+ years in senior corporate leadership.

div.p: A Global TRE™ Certified Provider has completed all three modules of the certification — personal practice, teaching one-to-one and teaching groups — including twelve online sessions of personal practice and supervision, under a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer accredited by TRE For All.
Certified providers are trained to recognise signs of over-activation, teach self-regulation, and adapt the exercises for different bodies and histories. That is what makes TRE™ safe to learn.
